subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Sep 14): Kalkbrenner, a banya day, drag wrestling
opener: Sample issue with made-up events, so you can judge the design and not the picks. Real issues search the live web every Monday at 6am and only ship things with a source.

picks.headline: Paul Kalkbrenner, live, at Knockdown Center
picks.title: Paul Kalkbrenner (Live)
picks.when: Fri Sep 18, doors 9pm, live set around 11:30
picks.why: Berlin Calling is in your library and this is the man who made it, playing live, not DJing, in the best big room in the city. It is the closest thing to a Berlin night you can get without the flight. Go with the guys and stay for the end; he builds.
picks.heads_up: Tier one is gone. Tier two is moving. Buy today.
picks.invite_text: Kalkbrenner is playing live at Knockdown Friday night. I'm getting tickets tonight, you in?

verification.note: Knockdown listing shows Fri Sep 18, doors 9pm.

picks.headline: Drag wrestling night at a Bushwick bar
picks.title: Slam! Drag Wrestling
picks.why: You said bars doing something weird, and this is a bar doing something weird: a real ring, real bumps, drag queens with finishing moves. It is a Thursday, it is a small room, and it is the kind of thing nobody in your group chat will have heard of.
picks.invite_text: Thursday: drag wrestling at a bar in Bushwick. Actual ring. I'm going, come.

picks.headline: A whole Saturday at the banya
picks.title: World Spa day pass
picks.when: Sat Sep 19, go at 11am and stay
picks.price: about $100 for the day, plus food
picks.why: Your best day last year was the Russian bathhouse with a friend. This is the bigger version: seven saunas, a cold plunge that means it, a Georgian restaurant upstairs. Six hours go by. Bring one friend who can sit still.
picks.heads_up: Saturdays fill up; book the day pass in advance.
picks.invite_text: Saturday banya day at World Spa. Sauna, plunge, khachapuri, repeat. 11am, you're coming.

picks.headline: Company XIV opens its fall show
picks.title: Company XIV: Seven Sins
picks.why: Your favorite room in the city, opening weekend, before the run gets talked about. The Halloween show you loved was this company on a good night; opening weekends are their best nights. Book the sitter for this one.
picks.heads_up: The good seats sell out first. The champagne-couch tier is the splurge but you already know that.
picks.invite_text: Company XIV opens Saturday. I got us two seats and a sitter. Dress up.

verification.note: Company XIV calendar shows Sat Sep 19 8pm.

picks.headline: Amapiano on the Elsewhere roof, daytime
picks.title: Piano People day party
picks.why: Everything you added to Spotify this month is Afrobeats and amapiano, and this is the crowd that actually dances to it, on a roof, in daylight, done by ten. Works with the guys, works as a date, works as the last outdoor party of the season.
picks.invite_text: Sunday afternoon amapiano party on the Elsewhere roof. 3pm start, home by 10. Come through.

picks.headline: A talk on LNG markets, with a bar after
picks.title: Columbia CGEP: The Next Decade of Gas
picks.venue: Columbia Center on Global Energy Policy
picks.why: Two former trading desk heads and a Qatari official arguing about where gas prices go. This is your commodity-trading interest with actual practitioners, not pundits. Ninety minutes, then a drink downtown.
picks.invite_text: Thursday 6pm: LNG market panel at Columbia, free. Nerdy but good. Drinks after?

radar.headline: Nutcracker tickets go on sale
radar.title: George Balanchine's The Nutcracker
radar.venue: David H. Koch Theater, Lincoln Center
radar.why: Your favorite night in the city. The good December Saturdays go within a week of on-sale.

radar.headline: A Muay Thai card at the Hulu Theater
radar.title: Lion Fight 100
radar.why: A real Muay Thai card in the city is rare. Get four seats together now; the lower bowl will not last.

anytime.headline: A new hidden bar under a Clinton Hill laundromat
anytime.title: Rinse Cycle
anytime.why: Twelve seats behind a working laundromat, ten minutes from your door, no sign, opened three weeks ago. Exactly your kind of place, and still quiet.

verification.note: Punch write-up and bar's booking page.

family.headline: Rock and Roll Playhouse plays the Beatles
family.title: Rock and Roll Playhouse: Music of the Beatles for Kids
family.why: A real band playing Rubber Soul in a real venue at a volume a 1-year-old can handle, done by 12:30, and you get to dance too. Beatles are all over your library; this is the version with a bubble machine.
family.invite_text: Sunday morning: a Beatles show for kids at Brooklyn Bowl, 11:30. Stroller-friendly. Then lunch. Yes?

notes: Fight cards inside this week were thin; the Lion Fight card is the one to plan around. One pick could not be re-checked this morning and is flagged.
